name: Kellyanne Conway

lean.basis: Republican pollster and strategist; chaired a pro-Cruz super PAC in 2016, then managed Trump's 2016 campaign and served as his counselor.

photo.credit: Official White House Photo by Stephanie Chasez

current_role: Political consultant and pollster; former counselor to the president (2017–2020)
summary: Kellyanne Conway, a Republican pollster, chaired the Mercer-funded pro-Cruz super PAC in the 2016 primaries, then became Trump's campaign manager in August 2016, the first woman to run a winning presidential campaign. As counselor to the president (2017–2020) she coined "alternative facts" and was cited for repeated Hatch Act violations.
